common_future_capture_requirements.exec_mechanism: Separately received direct argv launcher, no shell and no checkpoint/observer import
common_future_capture_requirements.output: Complete raw stdout/stderr and actual enclosing request/returns, including failure or timeout, retained only in separately root-selected owner-only private evidence; no raw config dump or environment values in workspace/chat/Git
common_future_capture_requirements.timeout_behavior: No automatic retry or successor. Root must separately select and receive owned-process bounded handling; a timeout or unknown closure remains failure/unknown, not success.
common_future_capture_requirements.pre_startup_boundary: No claim that -V or -G avoids dynamic-loader, randomness, account/NSS or ordinary platform startup. The displayed released source is not installed provenance.

proposals.purpose: Obtain actual local client/OpenSSL version banner, without selecting a connection target.
requires_before_run: Separate exact root diagnostic authorization and actual binary/startup-role binding
Private original capture with explicit bounded outer process handling
proposals.evidence_limit: A banner alone does not prove source correspondence, option support, defaults, authentication or no side effects.

proposals.purpose: Separately inspect option recognition and resulting candidate-policy fields/default-role path selection without any repository command or intended transport connection.
requires_before_run: Complete independently accepted D01 actual original, if root chose to run it
Independent installed-version/vendor-source analysis supporting -F none and the -G exit-before-transport branch
New explicit root decision about the old blanket no-G gate; this proposal does not override it
Accepted ordinary startup/NSS boundary and exact finite private capture plan
No unreceived diagnostic fields silently ignored
diagnostic_only_differences: CanonicalizePermittedCNAMEs=none is a diagnostic-only early-resolution guard
Numeric synthetic target with explicit remote user/port; not a connection or verification of the real repository endpoint
additional_fields_to_receive: No ordinary config source/callback evaluation under supported -F none
Actual user/global known-host role path strings kept private
Actual identity-agent and identity/certificate-default role selections kept private
Complete exit/stderr; unknown-option errors or unsupported-option warnings are not accepted away
proposals.evidence_limit: This would not prove an actual host-key exchange, successful auth, external-agent internals, full startup hermeticity, real-endpoint context or native/outer phase closure.
